title.narrative: Strengthening the Turkish Refugee Council and Promoting the Rights of Refugees and Host Communities in Turkey

description.narrative: The action aims the strengthen the Turkish Refugee Council (TRC) by expanding its network, develop a common agenda through consultation, better coordinating the work of members and address common challenges. The project will also improve the capabilities of the TRC and its members to contribute to policy and decision making as a result of the setting up of expert working groups, development of policy recommendations and participation in international networks.
